title: Start the Year with One Measurable Priority
teaser: Treating every goal as equally urgent can blur direction in the first week.
message: Choose one primary January outcome and write its success measure as a number date or explicit acceptance criterion.

title: Verify an Account Recovery Path
teaser: Strong passwords do not prevent lockout when recovery details are stale.
message: Check that the recovery email or phone for one important account is current and controlled only by you.

title: Test a Date Calculation Across New Year
teaser: The boundary between December 31 and January 1 can expose hidden date logic errors.
message: Run a safe test that crosses the year boundary and verify the calculated day difference against the expected value.

title: Prove a Required Field Is Actually Required
teaser: A visual required marker may not match the validation rule behind the form.
message: Submit a test form with one critical field empty and verify both the client and persistence layer reject it.

title: Put Monthly Fixed Costs on One Page
teaser: Scattered subscriptions and bills can make the real monthly burden look smaller.
message: List every recurring or automatic payment due this month and calculate their combined total separately.

title: Test a Rounding Rule at the Halfway Point
teaser: Exact half values can round differently across platforms and libraries.
message: Use an x.5 boundary in a decimal calculation and verify the result matches the documented rounding rule.

title: Use a Core Screen with Large Text
teaser: Increased text size can hide controls or clip headings even when default text looks fine.
message: Open an important screen with a large system text setting and verify primary actions remain reachable.

title: Record the Size of a Fresh Backup
teaser: An unexpectedly small backup can signal missing data or an incomplete export.
message: Create a new backup and record its file size beside the timestamp then compare it with a reasonable prior value.

title: Match CSV Headers to the Expected Schema
teaser: A renamed field can silently break import mappings.
message: Compare the column headers of one exported CSV with the exact headers required by its schema version.

title: Recheck the Default of a Privacy Setting
teaser: New features can unintentionally broaden old privacy assumptions.
message: Confirm one sharing or visibility setting starts with a reasonable least-exposure default for a new user.

title: Interrupt a Transaction with a Network Loss
teaser: A connection drop can leave a half-written record or an ambiguous success state.
message: In a safe test flow cut connectivity mid-operation and verify the app communicates retry rollback or final state clearly.

title: Leave Deliberate Capacity in the Week
teaser: A fully packed calendar turns the first surprise into a chain of delays.
message: Reserve a small part of this week's available time as intentional unplanned buffer.

title: Check Keyboard Focus Order on a Screen
teaser: A touch-first layout may still move keyboard focus in an illogical order.
message: Navigate one form using only the keyboard and verify focus follows a sensible visual and semantic sequence.

title: Pin the Version of a Third-Party Dependency
teaser: An undefined latest dependency can make the same build resolve differently later.
message: Confirm one critical dependency is fixed by an exact version or another verifiable lock record.

title: Update a Mid-Month Goal from Evidence
teaser: Changing a target can be the correct response when new evidence changes the plan.
message: Revisit January's main measure and record a one-sentence reason if current evidence justifies an adjustment.

title: Measure a List with a Thousand Records
teaser: A screen that is fast with sample data can degrade at realistic scale.
message: Create safe test data for a long list and observe load scrolling and filtering behavior at roughly a thousand records.

title: Compare a Download Hash with Its Published Checksum
teaser: Transport or cache problems can leave a same-named file with different contents.
message: When a trusted source publishes a checksum for a critical download compare it with your local hash.

title: Retest a Fix with the Original Failure Steps
teaser: A code change does not prove a defect is gone until the old trigger is exercised again.
message: Take one previously fixed bug and repeat its original reproduction steps from the starting state.

title: Give a Small Recurring Cost an Annual Number
teaser: A low monthly price can become meaningful when viewed across a full year.
message: Choose one recurring small charge and write its approximate twelve-month cost beside it.

title: Test a February Boundary Before It Arrives
teaser: Calendar defects often surface when month length changes.
message: Use safe test data around February 28 and when applicable February 29 to verify one date rule in advance.

title: Review the Lifetime of a Sharing Link
teaser: A persistent link can keep granting access after the original need has ended.
message: Open one previously created sharing link and expire or revoke it if continuing access is unnecessary.

title: Define a Trigger Threshold for One Risk
teaser: Naming a risk alone does not say when action should begin.
message: Pick one active risk and write the measurable threshold or event that will trigger intervention.

title: Compare Record Counts After a Restore
teaser: A success message alone does not prove every record returned.
message: Restore a safe backup in a test environment and compare key table counts with the pre-restore counts.

title: Add an Owner and Date to a Decision
teaser: A decision note without ownership and timing may never become action.
message: Open one recent decision and attach a single responsible owner plus a target date for the next step.

title: Make an Empty State Offer a Next Step
teaser: A screen that only says no data can leave the user at a dead end.
message: Open an important empty state and verify it offers a meaningful action such as create import or return.

title: Try an Import with an Extra Column
teaser: Unknown fields can create silent data loss or accidental mappings.
message: Add an unexpected column to a test CSV and verify the importer handles it explicitly and safely.

title: Verify the Day Count in a Monthly Report
teaser: A correct-looking total may still have been calculated over the wrong period.
message: Check that a January report covers exactly 31 unique expected dates before trusting its aggregate values.

title: Look for Identifying Data in a Log Sample
teaser: Debug logs can accidentally contain email addresses phone numbers or user-entered content.
message: Inspect logs from a safe test session and verify unnecessary personal data is absent or properly minimized.

title: Requalify Work Before Carrying It into February
teaser: Automatic rollover can keep low-value tasks alive indefinitely.
message: Review each unfinished January item and carry forward only the work that still has a clear reason to exist.

title: Record the Month's Most Useful Assumption
teaser: Remembering what worked without its reason weakens future learning.
message: Write down one important January assumption that held true and the single piece of evidence that supported it.

title: Close the Month with Reproducible Evidence
teaser: A remembered success is weaker than an output someone can inspect again.
message: Link one January improvement to a test result file hash or recorded measurement that can be checked later.
